assertions.assertion: JQL queries use the project key (TC) and vulnerability issue type ID (10024) from the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md — not hardcoded values (§1.49)
assertions.evidence: discovery-listing.md: 'Step 0 — Configuration Extracted: Project key: TC, Vulnerability issue type ID: 10024'. All three JQL queries use 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024'.

assertions.assertion: Three separate queries are constructed: one for untriaged issues (labels NOT IN ai-cve-triaged), one for triaged-but-new issues (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status = New), and one for Ready for QA candidates (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status NOT IN Closed, Verified, ON_QA) (§1.48)
assertions.evidence: Query 1: 'labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged)'. Query 2: 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status = New'. Query 3: 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status NOT IN (Closed, Verified, ON_QA)'. All three queries are separate and correctly structured.

assertions.assertion: Results are grouped into three clearly separated lists: Untriaged issues, Triaged but still New issues, and Ready for QA issues
assertions.evidence: discovery-listing.md has three separate sections with headers: '## Query 1: Untriaged Issues', '## Query 2: Triaged but still New', '## Query 3: Ready for QA'. Each has its own results table.

assertions.assertion: Each listed issue shows: issue key, status, CVE ID (from labels), summary, and created date
assertions.evidence: All result tables include columns: Issue (key), Status, CVE ID, Summary, Created. For example TC-9001 row: 'TC-9001 | New | CVE-2026-40112 | h2 - HTTP/2 rapid reset vulnerability [rhtpa-2.2] | 2026-06-08'

assertions.assertion: Status-aware handling: New issues (TC-9001, TC-9002, TC-9004) are presented for full triage, while the In Progress issue (TC-9003) triggers a warning about active work
assertions.evidence: status-handling.md: TC-9001, TC-9002, TC-9004 each show 'Handling: Proceed with full triage (default path)'. TC-9003: 'Handling: Warning — This issue is already in In Progress. It may be actively worked on.' with options to proceed or skip.

assertions.assertion: Ready for QA filtering: TC-9020 appears in Ready for QA (all linked Tasks Done/Closed), TC-9023 is excluded (TC-9025 still In Progress), TC-9026 is excluded (no Depend links)
assertions.evidence: discovery-listing.md: TC-9020 in 'Qualified — Ready for QA' with 'TC-9021 (Done), TC-9022 (Closed)'. Excluded section: TC-9023 'TC-9025 still In Progress — remediation is not complete', TC-9026 'No linked Tasks with type Depend — no remediation to verify'.
